title: Day 24 — Trie Autocomplete
prompt: The search box needs autocomplete backed by a trie. Insert already works; implement suggest(prefix, limit) to return the matching words. How do you approach it?

clarifications.answer: Return matches in ascending lexicographic order.
The prefix counts as a match if it was inserted as a word.
An empty prefix matches every inserted word.
If the prefix path doesn't exist, return [].
Return at most `limit` words; ideally stop as soon as you have that many rather than collecting all then slicing. limit 0 returns [].
Inserting the same word twice yields it once — the trie dedups naturally via the isWord flag.

hints: Two phases: (1) walk from the root following the prefix characters; if any is missing, return []. (2) collect words under the node you landed on.
To get lexicographic order, DFS the children in SORTED key order, and emit a node's word (if isWord) BEFORE descending into its children.
Reconstruct each word as prefix + the path descended; stop the DFS as soon as results reach `limit`.
